name: Marabou
run: vehicle compile queries -s spec.vcl -f MarabouQueries -o Marabou.queries/ --network f:fake.onnx

name: Agda
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Agda -o Agda.agda

name: AgdaVerify
run: vehicle compile itp -s spec.vcl -t Agda -o Agda.agda && agda -v0 -WnoUnsupportedIndexedMatch -i . -l vehicle-0.1.0 Agda.agda

name: DL2Loss
run: vehicle compile loss -s spec.vcl -l DL2Loss -o DL2Loss.vcl

name: Search
run: vehicle compile loss --lossMode Search -s spec.vcl -l DL2Loss -o Search.vcl
